item.title: How Do University Students Navigate Entrepreneurial Intention? Insight and Trends from Bibliometric Analysis
item.description: This paper will offer a bibliometric review of the literature on entrepreneurial intention among university students. The study uses a dataset of 942 Scopus-indexed articles published between 2016 and 2025 to analyse trends in publications, leading authors, institutions, journals, and countries and important thematic changes in the area. VOSviewer and RStudio were used to carry out bibliometric methods like co-citation analysis, keyword co-occurrence, bibliographic coupling and thematic mapping.
